network.description: Configure it once and model calls, image generation and workspace child processes all take this route. Saving applies immediately and survives restarts.
network.modeDesc: How every outgoing request finds its route. The default follows the system, so nothing about your current setup changes.
network.modeSystemHint: Use the operating system's proxy settings (macOS Network / Windows Internet Options).
network.modeDirectHint: Ignore every proxy, including the system one and any HTTP_PROXY in the environment.
network.modeManualHint: Send every request through the proxy server below.
network.systemNote: Following the system proxy. With no system proxy configured this behaves like a direct connection; you can switch back to manual at any time.
network.directNote: Direct connection: the app uses no proxy at all and ignores proxy environment variables.
network.serverDesc: HTTP, HTTPS (TLS to the proxy itself) and SOCKS5, with optional credentials.
network.protocolHint: HTTPS means the proxy port itself speaks TLS; local proxy apps usually use HTTP or SOCKS5.
network.addressHint: Hostname or IP, port 1–65535. Pasting a full URL strips the scheme for you
network.authHint: Leave empty when the proxy needs no login. The password is encrypted with the OS keychain and stored only on this machine.
network.bypassHint: Loopback (localhost / 127.0.0.1 / ::1) always stays direct. Separate entries with commas or spaces, e.g. *.corp.example.com
network.testDesc: Runs a real request with the current draft: dial the port, then reach the internet through the proxy and read the egress IP. Nothing is saved.
network.testHint: Proves the port is open and traffic actually takes the proxy
network.testNeedManual: Switch to manual mode to test
network.coverage: Covered: model and image requests in the main process, the renderer and embedded pages, and child processes such as git / npm started in the workspace.
network.unavailable: Proxy settings are unavailable in this environment

runtime.desc: One base environment for the whole company: commands and acceptance scripts in the workspace run through the interpreters chosen here. Node and Python are both active, with no per-employee override.
runtime.globalNote: This is a company-wide setting: changes apply to the next tool call and never interrupt a running task.
runtime.nodeDesc: System Node wins by default; Electron's bundled Node is only the fallback when none is installed.
runtime.pythonDesc: Point at the system Python 3, or at the interpreter inside a venv / conda environment.
runtime.autoHint: Auto-select uses the first available interpreter
runtime.addDesc: Useful for one nvm version, a venv or a conda environment. Saving makes it current for its language.
runtime.kindHint: One Node and one Python can be active at the same time
runtime.binaryHint: Must be an executable; venv / conda variables are detected automatically
runtime.name: Environment name
runtime.nameHint: Leave blank to name it after its directory
